title: The earliest modern humans outside Africa
bibliographicNote: Read the original four-page article, especially pp. 456–457 and Fig. 2. An accessible copy is at https://edisciplinas.usp.br/pluginfile.php/8744644/mod_resource/content/1/The%20earliest%20modern%20humans%20outside%20of%20Africa%20%28Hershkovits%20et%20al%202019%29.pdf . The file name says 2019; the paper was published on 26 January 2018. Its historical title is not adopted as a current claim that Misliya is the absolute earliest Eurasian sapiens fossil.
